subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: State Transition Testing
description: A micro-lesson that makes State Transition Testing usable.

hook.text: An ATM goes from idle to PIN entry to transaction to receipt. Each state has rules. Test the transitions.

buildup.text: State transition testing models the system as states and events that move it between them.

discovery.text: A state diagram shows valid transitions. Tests verify each transition and check that invalid ones are blocked.

twist.text: The real bugs hide in invalid transitions—what happens if you press 'withdraw' before entering a PIN?

climax.text: State testing catches sequence bugs that other techniques miss—especially in workflows and protocols.

punchline.text: Test the transitions, not just the states. Order matters.

quiz.question: What does state transition testing verify?
options: Valid and invalid transitions between system states
